generic_domain.justification: Meta-learning, also known as 'learning to learn', is the most generic and comprehensive research domain among the three. It encompasses techniques where models learn from their own learning processes, including methods that transfer knowledge across tasks or adapt quickly to new situations. Meta-reinforcement learning focuses specifically on applying meta-learning principles within reinforcement learning contexts, making it a subset of meta-learning. Similarly, online meta-learning deals with continuous adaptation and improvement as data arrives in real-time, which is also a specialized application under the broader umbrella of meta-learning.
